title: Asahina Mafuyu — Brand New Style〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The student council starts back up again today. I ended up becoming a class representative after the teacher and my classmates fervently asked me to...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I guess the one positive about this is that I don't have to get used to a new committee or anything...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. As energetic as ever I see.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Since you're here, am I correct in saying that you've also become a class representative?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, also...? Are you one too?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Everyone asked me to, so I decided to be one again this year.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wow... Even after changing classes, everyone believes that you'll do a good job of representing them!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's so amazing. I feel like you're one of those really reliable and hard-working people who are destined to lead...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My goal is to make sure Phoenix Wonderland keeps being a place that puts smiles on everyone's faces forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And in order to make that happen, my brothers suggested that I become a class representative. They said it'll be a good experience for me!

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina!
You're gonna be a class representative again?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I see you are as well. It's nice to see a familiar face.

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line: Likewise! I really had a lot of fun last year!

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line:
Wow, that's so pure and simple.
I'm doing this to try to boost my grades.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You say that, but you worked really hard last year and even stayed late after school often to put documents together.

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Haha! A part of me probably just doesn't want you to hog all the glory, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, Otori, I'm sorry.
These two are also class representatives.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They have quite a lot of experience now, so I'm sure they'll be able to teach you whatever you need.

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Otori...? Oh, didn't you work really hard on the sports festival last year with Haruka Kiritani last year?

rows.Speaker: Third-year
rows.Line: Everyone from the planning committee said you guys came up with a lot of great ideas and made things really fun in the end.

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line:
Wow...!
Then, we're really lucky to have you as a class representative!

rows.Speaker: Second-year
rows.Line: Let's do our best to make this school year a fun one.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah☆ You can leave making everyone smile to me♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I... I...!
I'm going to do everything I can to make it happen!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yes, let's do our best together.
